programs.title: Heartland
programs.desc: Just days before Lyndy's naming ceremony, the family finds themselves keeping secrets.

programs.title: The Royal Bake Off
programs.desc: Allie führt ein Café gegenüber ihrer ehrgeizigen Cousine Marily, und beide wetteifern um das beste Café. Als Prinz Henry in die Stadt kommt, fordert er sie zu einem Wettbewerb um das legendäre Familienrezept ihrer Großmutter, um den perfekten Krönungskuchen für die Hochzeit seines Bruders zu backen. Während Allie fair bleibt, ist Marily bereit, zu schummeln, um zu gewinnen.

programs.title: Finding Love in Saint Lucia
programs.desc: An Ornithologist and a Journalist partner up to save an endangered bird species in the jungle of Saint Lucia. They immediately fall in love with the nature, and in the process, they also fall for each other.

programs.title: The Soulmate Search
programs.desc: When Lindsay gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They mutually agree that the dating service is a complete bust and make a deal to get their money back.

programs.title: Love Switch
programs.desc: On the brink of divorce, James and Michelle have drifted apart over the years and couldn't be more different. Michelle despairs that they will never fully understand each other. On their 13th wedding anniversary, they wake up to discover they have somehow switched bodies. Unable to switch back, they are forced to understand what the other goes through on a daily basis. In the process, they develop a new sense of respect and understanding for one another.

programs.title: Bee My Love
programs.desc: A private chef competing for her dream job with a celebrity restaurateur finds inspiration in her mother's recipes, the sweetness of honey and a struggling beekeeper who teaches her to bee-lieve that life and love, are sweetest when shared.
